ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level ratio; predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across >95% of the visible surface with localized high-intensity (white) pixel disruptions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark pigmentation across both lobes. Distinct high-intensity white pixel clusters are localized at the distal tip of the right lobe and in sparse, unaligned linear configurations across the medial surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 50-55 degrees; notch depth is approximately 12-15% of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile. The right lobe trailing edge exhibits approximately 6-8 distinct peaks with pixel-depths ranging from 10-35 pixels. The left lobe trailing edge displays a more uniform, lower-amplitude serration frequency.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The left lobe follows a linear-convex sweep towards the distal tip. The right lobe exhibits a more pronounced convex curvature from the notch to the distal terminus.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel cluster detected at the distal tip of the right lobe. Isolated circular white pixel groups are present in the lower medial region of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-intensity white linear streaks detected; notably a vertically oriented parallel pair on the inner left lobe and several unaligned diagonal streaks on the central right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular pixel erosion and jaggedness along the continuous linear boundary of the trailing edge. Distinct high-intensity linear surface scarring on both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Concentrated high-intensity white marking at the absolute distal tip of the right fluke lobe, providing a localized point of maximal contrast against the dark surface.
